module.purpose: Provides the overlay utility that renders active scribble strokes onto the canvas, including color resolution, stroke geometry generation, opacity handling, and per-editor path caching.
module.summary: This module defines the scribble overlay contract and a canvas overlay utility for displaying eraser, lasso, laser, and related scribble interactions. It reads scribble state from the editor, converts points into SVG path geometry or a circular fallback, caches generated Path2D objects using relevant rendering inputs, and paints each overlay with theme-derived colors and opacity. A small color resolver maps semantic canvas colors to current theme values.
module.businessContext: Supports interactive drawing and selection feedback in the tldraw editor. Failure would prevent scribbles such as erasers, lasso selections, or laser pointers from appearing correctly.

units.name: ScribbleOverlayUtil

detail.name: ScribbleOverlayUtil
detail.summary: Provides the overlay utility for rendering and managing active scribble overlays in the editor. It exposes scribble-specific overlay metadata and maintains per-instance path caching.

specLiterals.role: Identifies this overlay utility and the overlay type it produces.
Public default z-index for scribble overlays.
Public default streamline value for scribble rendering.
Public cache-size bound for scribble paths.

units.name: render

detail.name: render
detail.signature: override render(ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, overlays: TLScribbleOverlay[]): void
preconditions: overlays contains overlay objects with scribble props conforming to TLScribbleOverlay.
The editor can provide a zoom level, current theme, and color mode.
postconditions: Each non-empty scribble overlay has its canvas rendering state configured for the scribble color and opacity.
A path is generated or retrieved for each non-empty scribble and stored in the scribble path cache when generated.
Empty scribbles are skipped without path generation or canvas rendering for that overlay.
invariants: A cached path is reused only when the scribble id, point count, final point coordinates, zoom, size, taper, and state match the cached entry.
Generated stroke size is scaled by the inverse of the current zoom level.
Pressure simulation is disabled for generated strokes.
The configured streamline option is passed to stroke generation.
The path cache is cleared when its size exceeds the configured cache size.
edgeCases: An overlay whose scribble has no points is skipped.
A generated stroke with fewer than four points is represented as a circular path centered on the final scribble point with radius scribble.size divided by twice the zoom level.
A scribble in state complete or stopping requests a final stroke from the stroke generator.
If any cached-path input changes, a new path is generated instead of reusing the cached path.
stateMutations: Mutates the internal _scribblePathCache by inserting generated paths and potentially clearing it.
detail.summary: Renders non-empty scribble overlays onto a canvas context using the current editor zoom, theme colors, color mode, and scribble rendering options. It reuses cached paths when the scribble geometry and rendering inputs are unchanged.

specLiterals.role: Scribble state that causes stroke generation to request the final stroke shape.
Scribble state that causes stroke generation to request the final stroke shape.

specTests.then: The scribble is skipped without creating or caching a path.
The cached Path2D is reused and stroke/path generation is not required for that scribble.
The scribble path is a circular path centered at its final point, with radius scribble.size divided by twice the current zoom.
